register.labelZh: CLOSE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: close down 可以表示企業或服務永久停止營運；close out 則特別適合描述店舖在結業前減價售出餘下貨品。；close in 可以表示人們從不同方向逐漸靠近；close on 則可以表示跑手、車輛或船隻逐漸追近前方的人或物。；close something off 可以表示禁止人物或車輛進入某個地方；close something out 則可以表示窗簾或百葉簾阻擋光線。；CLOSE 片語動詞可以描述手指抓住物件、眼睛因腫脹而合上，以及職員在一天結束時關閉並鎖好店舖。
register.summaryEn: Close down can describe a business or service that permanently stops operating. Close out is especially useful when a shop ends business by selling its remaining goods at reduced prices. Close in can show people approaching from different directions. Close on can describe a runner, vehicle or boat getting nearer to something ahead. Close something off can describe stopping people or vehicles from entering an area. Close something out can describe curtains or blinds blocking light. The CLOSE family can describe fingers gripping an object, swollen eyes becoming shut, and workers securing a shop at the end of the day.
